study: P0-R4 DataExport0806 4-dataset feasibility preflight (R3-S/R3-P blocker resolution)
purpose: Read-only, minimal-representative-file check of whether DataExport0806 is sufficient to resolve P0-R3's R3-S/R3-P core blockers for monthly_revenue, financial_statements, institutional_gross, tdcc_weekly -- BEFORE committing to a full 2.2GB candidate build.
method: Read raw .xlsx files directly with openpyxl (read_only=True), reading only the columns needed to answer each question. No tej_importer/build_v2_candidate/verifier code invoked. No candidate cache, no lock, no parity/performance computation, no writes to any tracked or production path. Files chosen: single/near-minimal representative files per dataset (the sole file for monthly_revenue; the sole primary file for financial_statements; 4 of 16 institutional_flow/institutional_gross source files spanning the full date range; 1 of 9 tdcc_weekly files, cross-checked against directory listing only for the rest).
not_done_this_round: No full-corpus scan (only representative files read, not all files/rows for every dataset)
No candidate parquet written, no cache/, no build_receipts/, no quality_sidecars/

checks.detail: Single raw file spans 2004-01 through 2026-07 (478127 rows total, per-year row counts all >0, no gap years). Fully covers the 255-canonical-month target range (2005-01→2026-03) and beyond.

Column 營收發布日 (release_date) exists and is structurally present in every row (0% blank). However, a precise per-row classification (genuine parseable date vs the literal placeholder token '.') shows a hard transition: 2004-01 through 2012-12 (9 full years, 96 of the 255 canonical months) are 100% the placeholder token '.' -- NOT genuine dates -- for every single row in those years. 2013-01 onward is ~100% genuine parseable dates (a handful of stray '.' rows in 2022-2026, <0.1%). This is a real improvement over the previously-documented tej_cache snapshot (genuine release_date only from 2019+) -- DataExport0806 extends genuine per-row disclosure-date coverage back to 2013 -- but it is NOT full 255-month (2005-2026) genuine coverage. 2005-01 through 2012-12 remains without a genuine disclosure date in even this newest export.

year_by_year_dot_vs_genuine.2022_through_2026: >=99.9% genuine (1-12 stray '.' rows per year out of 12000-24000)

checks.evidence_ref: same file as above; read-only openpyxl scan of column 營收發布日, regex-classified genuine vs '.' vs blank, per-year tally over all 478127 rows

checks.detail: revenue_yoy is not something this study needs to derive/reconstruct from components -- the raw column 單月營收成長率％ (renamed revenue_yoy_pct by the existing DATASETS spec) IS the figure the actual B-leg screening code (scripts/tej_universe_screen_validation.py, which reads revenue_growth's revenue_yoy_pct directly with no recomputation) already consumes as-is. This raw column is 94.0-99.5% populated with genuine numeric values in every year 2004-2026 (remainder is the same '.' placeholder token, plausibly IPO-year/no-prior-year-comparator gaps, not a coverage collapse). No new formula is required; the existing formula is simply 'read revenue_yoy_pct directly'.
checks.caveat: This confirms the VALUE is present at high density throughout; it does not by itself confirm WHEN each value became genuinely knowable (see genuine_release_date_field_coverage_and_missingness above) -- value-presence and disclosure-date-presence are two independent claims per this study's own non-claim 3, not conflated here.
checks.evidence_ref: same file as above; column 單月營收成長率％

datasets.next_step: If P0-R4's Track B is separately authorized: build a per-dataset VintageAvailabilityRecord/PitEvidenceRecord splitting monthly_revenue into two sub-ranges -- 2013-01→2026-07 (genuine_evidence_fraction=1.0, eligible for Gate R4-P consideration) and 2005-01→2012-12 (genuine_evidence_fraction=0.0, must be declared NOT_RECONSTRUCTIBLE for that sub-range per Track A non-claim 1 -- current/'.'-substitution is explicitly prohibited). A 255-month EXACT identity for revenue_yoy PIT-availability is not achievable from this raw source alone; a reduced 168/255-month genuine window is.

datasets.overall_status_correction_note: CORRECTED this round: previously recorded PASS. Downgraded because 'the raw data is 100% genuine' and 'R3-P is resolved' are two different claims that must not be conflated -- the producing chain (core.tej_bundle._to_long, per P0-R3's own already-archived finding) does NOT currently consume release_date; it still applies the uniform PUBLISH_LAG_DAYS=45 fixed-lag proxy. Per this study's own AC-R4-10 rule (field presence alone never satisfies Gate R4-P; actual code consumption is required), R3-P remains UNRESOLVED for financial_statements until that code is changed -- a future, separately-authorized implementation step, not something this data-only preflight can or does complete. DATA_AVAILABLE_IMPLEMENTATION_REQUIRED names both halves of this honestly: the data-sufficiency half is genuinely PASS (kept below, unchanged), the code-consumption half is not done.

checks.detail: Primary file spans 2005-01 through 2026-06/Q2 (138731 rows, per-year counts all >0). A second, small supplementary file ('202606 財報583家 8-10.xlsx', 596 rows) appears to be a later Q2-2026-specific correction batch for 583 companies -- not examined in depth this round (not needed to answer the coverage question, main file already covers the same period).

Column 財報發布日 (release_date) is 100% genuine parseable dates in EVERY year 2005-2026 (138731/138731 rows), verified with the same strict regex classification used for monthly_revenue (which caught the '.' placeholder issue there) -- zero '.' placeholders, zero blanks, zero other-format values found in financial_statements.
checks.evidence_ref: same file; column 財報發布日, full-file scan

checks.detail: The 56-column schema contains no restatement/original-vs-restated flag or any second value per (stock, period) -- this is a single current-snapshot export, one row per (stock,quarter), consistent with the already-established V2_CANDIDATE_RESTATED_SNAPSHOT characterization. This means the export cannot support Track A first-vintage/historical-revision reconstruction (a separate, already out-of-scope-for-this-preflight question) -- but that is NOT what R3-P's 45-day-fixed-lag concern is about. R3-P concerns PIT-availability-of-consumption (does a genuine disclosure date exist and get used), which is fully answered PASS above.

Given 100% genuine release_date coverage across the full target range, replacing core.tej_bundle._to_long's uniform PUBLISH_LAG_DAYS=45 fixed-lag proxy with the genuine per-row release_date is technically feasible from a data-availability standpoint. No production code was read for modification and none was modified this round or the prior round (out of scope). CORRECTED framing: this is a data-sufficiency finding only -- it does NOT mean R3-P is resolved for financial_statements. consumed_by_producing_chain remains false; the fixed 45-day proxy is still what production actually uses today.

datasets.next_step: If Track B is separately authorized: build PitEvidenceRecord for financial_statements with cutoff_semantics.kind='genuine_field', consumed_by_producing_chain=false (still using the 45-day proxy in production as of this preflight) -- Gate R4-P requires demonstrating actual code consumption, not just field presence, per this study's own AC-R4-10 rule. Until that separately-authorized implementation step happens, financial_statements' R3-P status is DATA_AVAILABLE_IMPLEMENTATION_REQUIRED, not resolved.

datasets.overall_status_correction_note: CORRECTED this round: previously recorded PASS. Downgraded because the underlying evidence was 4 of 16 source files checked for header presence and only 1 of 16 files checked for genuine content (first 50000 rows of the 2004 file only) -- this is a real, positive, decisive-DIRECTION signal (no placeholder trap found where checked, unlike monthly_revenue's release_date), but it is a SAMPLE, not a full-corpus confirmation. Per this study's own AC-R4-14 rule (full-corpus, not sample -- a sampled result never yields SUFFICIENT, at most NOT_FULLY_EVALUATED), this preflight's finding must not be reported as a clean full-corpus PASS. PARTIAL_FEASIBLE names both halves honestly: feasible/promising on the evidence gathered, but not yet a full-corpus confirmation.

checks.detail: All 6 required institutional_gross columns (外資買進張數/外資賣出張數/投信買進張數/投信賣出張數/外資總投資股率%/投信持股率%) are present in the header of all 4 representative files checked (2004, 2012, 2019-2020, 2025-20260806) out of 16 total institutional_flow/institutional_gross source files spanning 2004-2026 -- same source_dir/files P0-R3 already rated SUFFICIENT for institutional_flow.

checks.detail: P0-R3 previously found the on-disk tej_cache for institutional_gross covers only 2026-04-01→2026-07-16 (255/255 canonical months missing), apparently contradicting tej_importer.py's own docstring claim of 2004-01-02+ coverage. This preflight's SAMPLE (4/16 files by header, 1/16 by content) is consistent with the docstring's 2004+ claim being accurate relative to the raw DataExport0806 export, and consistent with the narrow tej_cache range being a defect/staleness in a prior build process rather than genuine data unavailability -- but a sample supporting a hypothesis is not the same as a full-corpus confirmation of it. CORRECTED framing: this is the LIKELY explanation on the evidence gathered, not a RESOLVED fact -- the 12 unexamined files could, in principle, contain a gap this sample missed.

datasets.next_step: If Track B is separately authorized: a proper Phase B build (or, short of a full build, a full-corpus read-only scan of all 16 files) is required before institutional_gross can be reported SUFFICIENT/PASS per this study's own AC-R4-14 full-corpus rule. This preflight sampled 4/16 files by header + 1/16 by content; the intervening 12 files were not opened this round (per the minimal-representative-file efficiency rule) and remain unconfirmed. PARTIAL_FEASIBLE, not PASS, is the honest status until that full-corpus check happens.

checks.detail: Per explicit instruction, ran 4 quality checks on the new 集保比率 export before any candidate build is even considered (no build performed). checks.detail: CORRECTED this round -- the prior round's 'NOT_REQUIRED' finding is WRONG; it searched beat_0050/strategies/high52_lab.py, core/canonical_universe.py, and the B-leg screening script, but never searched beat_0050/realbody/, where a real, live dependency exists. Independently re-verified this round by reading the actual source (not taken on assertion): full call chain, each link confirmed by direct code read: (1) beat_0050/realbody/build_realbody_scores.py line 120 (inside its scoring worker): `from beat_0050.realbody.bt_bundle import bt_fetch_history`, called at line 124 as `bt_fetch_history(sid)`. (2) beat_0050/realbody/bt_bundle.py line 61-63: `def bt_fetch_history(symbol, name=None): ... b = _tb.tej_fetch_history(symbol, name)` where `_tb` (line 23) is `import core.tej_bundle as _tb` -- the module's own docstring states it only overrides two specific behaviors on top of tej_fetch_history and explicitly does not touch _tej_shareholding. (3) core/tej_bundle.py line 221-236, function tej_fetch_history(): constructs and returns `HistoryBundle(..., shareholding=_tej_shareholding(symbol))` unconditionally -- shareholding is not one of the two overridden behaviors, so this call is not bypassed by the bt_bundle wrapper. (4) core/tej_bundle.py's _tej_shareholding() (confirmed in the prior preflight round) reads tdcc_weekly.total_lots_thousand as its shares-outstanding proxy. This is therefore a real, verified, indirect A-leg dependency via the 'realbody' scoring pipeline (build_realbody_scores.py) -- separate from, and missed by, the direct-reference search of high52_lab.py/canonical_universe.py/tej_universe_screen_validation.py performed in the prior round.
chain: beat_0050/realbody/bt_bundle.py:61-63 (bt_fetch_history calls core.tej_bundle.tej_fetch_history, does not override shareholding)
checks.caveat: This reverses the prior round's finding for the specific realbody/build_realbody_scores.py path; it does not by itself establish whether 'realbody' scoring is the same construct as the P0-R3-defined decision-time universe (Panel.tier_valid) or a separate/parallel pipeline -- that remains unconfirmed. checks.detail: The 4-part quality gate above (date uniqueness, stock code, tier-ratio-sum, total-lots reconciliation) validates that 年月日 is a well-formed, internally-consistent AS-OF/observation date for each weekly snapshot -- it does NOT establish WHEN that snapshot became genuinely publicly available/known (a separate claim, per this study's own non-claim 3). No evidence was gathered this round (or the prior round) of an actual publish-lag between 年月日 and real-world public release -- unlike financial_statements/monthly_revenue, tdcc_weekly's raw export carries no separate release_date-style field at all; 年月日 is the only date column. TDCC's own public open-data product (per core/tdcc_provider.py's docstring) is described as weekly, updated Friday evening, with 'up to about one week' of inherent lag -- but this is a docstring comment about a DIFFERENT ingestion mechanism (live weekly scrape), not verified evidence about this TEJ Pro export's own publish timing.
checks.evidence_ref: same 5 files checked for the quality gate above; core/tdcc_provider.py docstring (read-only, cited for context only, not treated as evidence about the TEJ Pro export's own timing)

formal_identity_window_decision.approval_status: NOT_YET_FORMALLY_APPROVED -- this is a PROPOSAL surfaced through this preflight's conversation, not a decision recorded in any prereg or prereg-erratum document. It has no standing as a binding scope change for P0-R4/R3-S/R3-P until it goes through this study's own documented approval mechanism (a new checkpoint/erratum on the governing prereg, reviewed and explicitly approved) -- the same discipline this study has applied to every other scope/window decision throughout. This preflight and its artifacts record the proposal and the evidence behind it; they do not themselves constitute that approval.
formal_identity_window_decision.rationale: monthly_revenue's genuine per-row release_date (2013+, established in the prior round of this preflight) and tdcc_weekly's genuine coverage from the new 集保比率 export (2013+, established this round) now share the same 2013 starting point. The proposal is to no longer pursue the original 255-month (2005-01 to 2026-03) exact identity window -- 2005-2012 would be out of scope for the identity window, not silently treated as covered.
formal_identity_window_decision.not_yet_reconciled: financial_statements (100% genuine 2005-2026, wider than 2013+) and institutional_gross (raw coverage per this preflight's PARTIAL_FEASIBLE sample, wider than 2013+) both individually support a WIDER window than 2013+ -- the 2013-01 to 2026-03 window is therefore the binding constraint from monthly_revenue/tdcc_weekly, not a limitation shared by all four datasets. This asymmetry is recorded, not resolved, this round.

overall_verdict.coverage_detail: Within the PROPOSED (not yet approved) 2013-01 to 2026-03 window, all four datasets have read-only evidence supporting coverage feasibility: monthly_revenue (full), financial_statements (full, wider than needed), institutional_gross (PARTIAL_FEASIBLE -- sample-based, not full-corpus), tdcc_weekly (2013+ confirmed in the new out-of-repo TEJ Pro export, quality gate passed).
overall_verdict.pit_detail: Coverage feasibility is NOT the same claim as PIT (R3-P) resolution, and none of the four datasets has R3-P actually resolved yet: financial_statements is DATA_AVAILABLE_IMPLEMENTATION_REQUIRED (genuine release_date exists but the producing chain does not consume it -- still the 45-day fixed-lag proxy in production); monthly_revenue's genuine release_date only covers 2013+ within the data itself, and no code change has been made to consume it either; institutional_gross's PIT semantics were not examined this round at all (out of this preflight's original 4-question scope); tdcc_weekly is UNRESOLVED_AVAILABILITY_NOT_PROVEN -- its 年月日 is confirmed to be a well-formed AS-OF/observation date, not a proven genuine public-availability date, and it is REQUIRED_BY_A_LEG_INDIRECTLY (via build_realbody_scores.py -> bt_bundle.bt_fetch_history -> core.tej_bundle.tej_fetch_history -> _tej_shareholding -> tdcc_weekly), so this gap is not academic -- it feeds a real scoring path.
overall_verdict.window_approval_detail: The 2013-01 to 2026-03 identity window discussed in this round's conversation is a proposal under this preflight's own read-only, non-binding scope -- it has not been run through this study's documented approval mechanism (new prereg checkpoint/erratum) and must not be treated as an approved scope change by any future phase until it is.

recommendation: Do not proceed to any candidate build, code change, or scope commitment on the strength of this preflight alone. If the 2013-01 to 2026-03 proposed window is to become the study's actual target, that requires its own explicit approval via this study's documented prereg/erratum mechanism -- not implied by this conversation. Separately and regardless of the window question: financial_statements and monthly_revenue both need a future, separately-authorized implementation step (making the producing chain actually consume release_date) before R3-P can be scored resolved for either; institutional_gross needs a full-corpus (not sampled) check before R3-S can be scored SUFFICIENT; tdcc_weekly needs both a full-corpus check and a genuinely evidenced publish-availability lag (not just a validated as-of date) before either R3-S or R3-P can be scored resolved for it, and its newly-confirmed indirect A-leg dependency (via build_realbody_scores.py) means this is not a low-stakes gap. This preflight does not itself authorize any Track B/Phase B action, any file move, any importer change, or any candidate build -- read-only feasibility finding only, awaiting review.
